title: flightdeck/workflows-list/v1
description: Each workflow graph record under /workflow-graphs/ in the board, with its title, subject, node count and whether Flightdeck draws it.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

next.description: The next steps, in the order the text prints them. It is absent when there are none.

commands.description: The commands that carry out the step, in order.

call.description: A command line of this tool.

run.description: A command line of another program.

text.description: The sentence or phrase that the text prints for the step.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

GraphRow.description: One graph, as the Workflows rail and switch name it.

code.description: Board's code, or flightdeck's, of a degraded record, or null.

made.description: When the reading was written, or null.

nodes.description: The number of nodes, or null.

problems.description: The number of problems that the check finds.

slug.description: The graph's slug, the last part of its path.

subject.description: The path of the record or file the graph reads, or null.

title.description: The graph's title, or null when flightdeck cannot read the record.

oneOf.description: The record passes its schema and the check, so the page draws it.

Board marks the record degraded, or flightdeck cannot read it, so
the page draws no graph and shows the code.
The check finds problems, so the page lists them and draws no graph.

ListSummary.description: What the Workflows rail entry says.

drawn.description: The number of graphs that Flightdeck draws.
